offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures positive displacement pumps, flow meters, valves, dispensing and dosing systems, and other highly engineered fluidics components. Sells mainly to OEMs and industrial, life science, water, energy, food and semiconductor customers. Products are made in many plants and often custom-engineered to applications.

primary_products.value: positive displacement pumps; flow meters and controls; valves and fluid-handling components; dispensing and dosing systems; fire and rescue equipment; optical and photonics components

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts and repair services; application engineering support

customer_segment.value: B2B: OEMs, industrial manufacturers, life science and pharma companies, water utilities, chemical and energy firms, food processors; B2G: fire departments and municipal water and wastewater agencies

end_markets.value: industrial processing; water and wastewater; life sciences and pharmaceuticals; chemicals and energy; food and beverage; semiconductors; fire and safety

revenue_model.value: product sales: engineered pumps, meters, valves and components sold to OEMs and end users; service fees: aftermarket parts, repair and maintenance

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds engineered pumps, flow and dispensing equipment from metals, plastics and purchased parts, sold to OEMs and end users; component supplier: supplies critical fluidics and optical components into customers' machines and instruments

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, manufacturing plants across many countries

specialization.value: related lines: fluid and metering technologies, health and science technologies, fire and safety/diversified products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to OEMs and large industrial and life science accounts; distributors / dealers: industrial distributors and fire equipment dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, environmental and trade rules, some pharma, food and fire-equipment standards (FDA, NFPA, NSF)

notes: Segment names and recent portfolio changes (e.g., acquisitions or divestitures) may be slightly out of date.
